items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: Well mostly fell there was a lot of guitar players like Willie San Diego. You know Mr. Willie San Diego.

ctx.x: So we know that he was great. And who were some of the others that you liked when you were a kid?

Well mostly fell there was a lot of guitar players like Willie San Diego. You know Mr. Willie San Diego. Also Mr. Lloyd Kepper. I know your name is Lloyd Kepper. Oh yes. Mr. Lloyd Kepper. A lot of other people I can't think about the name.
What about this fella Payne that you mentioned? Richard Payne. Was he really good?
